function.description: Send tokens OR the chain's native gas asset (ETH, POL, …) from the agent wallet to an address. For native, pass token='native'. Simulated and asserted against your declared max_spend_usd before anything is broadcast. dry_run defaults to TRUE — set it false to actually move funds.
function.name: defi_trade_transfer

account.description: Optional — work FROM the token-bound (ERC-6551) account of an NFT this treasury OWNS, instead of from the treasury: the account's assets move, the treasury signs as the NFT's owner. A 0x account address. Only accounts of a collection the owner pinned. Needs AGENT_NFT_ENABLED. What each account kind can do: Tokenbound AccountV3: the NFT's owner drives it with CALL only (no DELEGATECALL, no admin call); it has a lock and an ERC-2771 forwarder, may hold standing approvals, and accepts the owner's signature as its own (ERC-1271). ERC-6551P account: the NFT's owner drives it with CALL only (no DELEGATECALL, no admin call); it has no lock and no forwarder, signs nothing, refuses a standing approval (an ERC-20 spend approves, spends and resets in one batch), and its NFT cannot be sold while an ERC-6551 account owns it.

chain.description: Chain to send on — CHOOSE IT DELIBERATELY, because the same address is a different token on a different chain. Chains that can move value: ethereum, base, robinhood, arbitrum, polygon. Gas differs by orders of magnitude, so a cent-scale trade can cost more in gas on ethereum than it is worth, while base is a fraction of a cent. Per-chain guidance: the `chain` parameter of defi_trade.swap.

dry_run.description: TRUE (default) simulates and returns the guard's verdict without broadcasting. Set false to actually move funds.

max_spend_usd.description: The most USD you authorize for this transfer. Asserted against the SIMULATED outflow — if the simulation disagrees, the transfer is refused.

nft.description: Optional — the same as `account`, naming the NFT instead: '<collection>#<id>', or just '<id>' when one collection is pinned on the chain.

send_anyway.description: Only for a token whose value is NOT VERIFIED (no spend-grade price). It sends only on the owner's own turn; your call goes to the owner.

token.description: CONTRACT ADDRESS of the token to send (0x…), or 'native' to send the chain's gas asset itself (ETH on ethereum/base/arbitrum/robinhood, POL on polygon). A token ticker is not accepted — resolve it to an address with defi_data.token_resolve first.
